description: Support and resistance map. Up to five support and five resistance levels from clustered daily swing pivots, high-volume nodes and round numbers, each with kind, strength (1-5) and touch count, plus the nearest level on each side. Computed from the last 30 daily candles (cached 15 minutes). Use nearestSupport/nearestResistance as stop-loss/take-profit anchors for a position already open; higher strength and touch count mean a more reliable level. Costs $0.005 USDC per call (x402).
name: get_support_resistance
